entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is 772-VFB-901.

Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Pulling up order 772-VFB-901 now... I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference?
It's a preference. It's also something I tried to do weeks ago but your website was broken.
I'm very sorry to hear you had trouble with the site. Do you recall what happened? Understanding that will help me document the issue.
It was just a generic website error. The whole return system was down. I couldn't print a label or even get to the final page.

I understand. We did have a known service outage about four weeks ago; it sounds like you were trying to make the return right when our system was down. I sincerely apologize for that inconvenience. Did you happen to grab a screenshot of the error message at the time?
Yes, I have a screenshot. It was pointless.

I appreciate you confirming that. Let me just check the policy for you here... Okay, I see your delivery was 37 days ago. That's no problem at all. You're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window for the VeloBand.
Fine. So all that hassle with the website didn't even matter. Whatever.

While I'm sorry you had to call in, I am happy I can resolve this for you right now. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I've just sent it to the email on your account. Is there anything else I can help with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
